controls.label: Car
controls.hint: Which car you drive: a short quick rally car, a long muscle car, or a tall heavy pickup. Same driving code on all three, worked out from each one's size.

controls.label: Grip
controls.hint: How hard the tyres hold. Low and it slides wide through every turn; high and it goes where it points.

controls.label: Power
controls.hint: The engine and its top speed together.

controls.label: Slow motion
controls.hint: Slows the whole world down, the car with it. 0 is full speed; 0.9 is a tenth of it.

controls.label: Car gravity
controls.hint: What pulls on the car; the rest follows from this and its length. 65 moves as the 3 m car in folio-2025 does; 9.8 like a real car.

controls.label: Full lock
controls.hint: How far the front wheels turn, in radians.

controls.label: Boost
controls.hint: How many times the engine boost adds. 0 turns it off.

controls.label: Seconds on its roof
controls.hint: How long it lies upside down before it rights itself.

triggers.label: Reset
triggers.hint: Back to the start: every control, the car, the crates, the mannequin and the view.
